probes.name: E5-reflected-xss
probes.research_question: Does the reflected-XSS module echo an event-handler payload into an executable HTML context without authentication, and is that distinguishable from ordinary reflection?
probes.hypothesis: Unauthenticated GET /vulnerabilities/xss_r/?name= reflects the value verbatim inside <pre>, so a script/event-handler payload executes in a victim browser.

probes.name: E7-local-file-inclusion
probes.research_question: Can an unauthenticated client make the application include an arbitrary absolute path?
probes.hypothesis: GET /vulnerabilities/fi/?page=<path> passes the value to PHP include(), so absolute and traversal paths disclose arbitrary readable files to an unauthenticated client.

probes.name: E6-command-injection
probes.research_question: Does the command-injection module concatenate user input into a shell command, and under which OS identity does that command run?
probes.hypothesis: POST /vulnerabilities/exec/ with ip=127.0.0.1;id executes `id` in the web server's shell context (not root).
probes.privilege_note: identity is the application's own service account; see docs/privilege-boundary-assessment.md
